name: Coastcare Victoria Community Grants
summary: Grants for not-for-profit, community-led environmental groups to deliver projects that help the community care for the marine and coastal environment.

status.quote: 2026 Coastcare Victoria Community Grants Up to $250,000 for projects that assist the community in caring for the marine and coastal environment. Status: Closed

applicant_types.quote: Who can apply: Not-for-profit groups Funding: $1 - $10,000 The annual Coastcare Victoria Community Grants enable community-led environmental groups and organisations

amount.quote: Who can apply: Not-for-profit groups Funding: $1 - $10,000

pool.quote: The Victorian Government is investing up to $250,000 through the Sustainability Fund for the Coastcare Victoria Community Grants.
